FISHING LICENCE · UNITED STATES

Indiana fishing licence

Adult visitors need a fishing licence. The one-day licence includes trout and salmon privileges, but longer licences can need an added stamp.

Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Non-residents aged 18 or older, unless exempt.

Who doesn’t

  • Non-residents aged 17 or younger.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Non-resident 1-day, including trout/salmonnon resident1 calendar day$15 USD
Non-resident 7-daynon resident7 consecutive days$35 USD
Non-resident annualnon residentApril 1, 2026–March 31, 2027$60 USD

Extra stamps and permits

  • Trout/Salmon Stamp Privilege · $11 USD
    Required for trout or salmon privileges with a licence that does not include them.

Rules visitors should know

  • Annual licences and stamp privileges expire March 31.
  • The seven-day licence excludes trout and salmon privileges unless the stamp is added.

How to buy

Use Indiana's online outdoor licence system or a licence retailer.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Indiana?

Adult visitors need a fishing licence. The one-day licence includes trout and salmon privileges, but longer licences can need an added stamp.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in Indiana?

Non-resident 1-day, including trout/salmon: $15 USD; Non-resident 7-day: $35 USD; Non-resident annual: $60 USD (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Indiana?

Use Indiana's online outdoor licence system or a licence retailer.
